name: uketsugi
description: Memory and task handoff for this project's agents: the server's tools, a brief before the first prompt, and a note of where each session stopped.

url.title: Server address
url.description: Where your uketsugi server is, without /mcp: on its own machine, http://127.0.0.1:7410.

token.title: Token
token.description: The token your harness sends: `ukt token` prints it on the server's host, or whoever runs the server gave you one.
